summary: Transportation infrastructure and public health are improved by providing access to bike-sharing services. This project documents APIs for various bike-sharing platforms worldwide, enabling multimodal routing apps to show nearby bikes. The project's focus on bike-sharing services benefits urban residents, commuters, and tourists, particularly in densely populated areas. The documentation of bike-sharing APIs supports the development of sustainable transportation systems, reducing reliance on personal vehicles and promoting environmentally friendly modes of transportation. The project's scope encompasses global bike-sharing platforms, with a focus on Europe and North America.
